title: Bound concurrent Engram doctor invocations and account for lingering readers
outcome: Consolidated final20-file Claude Low findings: Verify and Save can concurrently run doctor for300s against the same project/store with blocking workers, two readers and up to8MiB per stream. Add per-project single-flight or explicit busy response, with concurrency tests. Separately account for detached readers after timeout: single-flight until request return alone does not bound accumulation across sequential retries when Unix descendants retain pipes. Define resource lifetime/admission policy and test it rather than claiming single-flight fixes lingering readers. Existing tm-ng02 covers bounded request return and safe cleanup; no matching concurrency task found by tracker title/description search. Source inspection only; no resource-exhaustion reproduction.
